concept: Fixing a mistake when you can, instead of just apologizing and moving on
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character not only apologizes for a mistake but also does something to help fix it
exercise.reflection_prompt: How is fixing something different from just saying sorry?
exercise.practice: Student thinks of a small mistake and names one way they could help fix it, not just apologize

assessment.success_marker: student proposes a real fixing action, distinct from an apology alone
